sections.content: Maya, Mexica and Inca identify different societies in different regions and periods. They should not be treated as one civilisation.

items.spanish: El mundo maya ocupó varias regiones.
items.english: The Maya world occupied several regions.

items.spanish: Los mexica construyeron un gran centro político.
items.english: The Mexica built a major political centre.

items.spanish: El Estado inca controló un territorio extenso.
items.english: The Inca state controlled a large territory.

sections.content: These societies had different histories, languages and political structures.
